title: Canonical Source-Dependent Global Admissibility Gate
scope: current frozen architecture plus the audited incidence/state-weighted and PSD-positivity construction class; not all conceivable deeper nonlinear laws
core_distinction: Source action on a state or visible datum under a fixed compatibility/positivity rule is not by itself a source-dependent deformation of the admissibility law.

incidence_only.name: Incidence-Only Cycle-Defect No-Go
incidence_only.statement: For graph incidence B and the orthogonal cycle projector P_cyc = I - B^T(BB^T)^+B, P_cyc B^T = 0. A canonical incidence-exact node-source 1-cochain has no cycle-space component.

canonicality.name: State-Weighted Admissibility Canonicality Obstruction
canonicality.statement: Within the audited covariant weighted-incidence class eta_f = P_cyc W_f B^T C, multiple positive scalar functionals of the same edge invariant produce nonzero, source-linear, relabeling-covariant but inequivalent source-to-cycle-defect maps. The frozen structural rules tested here do not select one functional or coefficient.

positivity.name: Positivity Non-Selection Result
positivity.statement: At a faithful positive-definite center, positivity admits a common open neighborhood containing all audited bounded candidate directions. At a simple PSD boundary, first-order positivity supplies a half-space condition with a 9-dimensional lineality subspace in Sym(4), not a unique source direction. Positivity is therefore a feasibility filter, not a canonical source-map generator in this audit.

positive_control.interpretation: Once a weighting functional and coefficient are explicitly declared, the map is unique by construction. This proves gate sensitivity but is added structure, not a derivation.

allowed_restart_conditions: one explicit independently motivated source-to-higher-incidence/admissibility axiom
one independently calibrated physical cross-domain observable that selects the deformation
